name: skill-doctor
description: Tools for people who build Claude and Codex skills: map how a skill works and QA it before you ship it.

plugins.name: skill-doctor
plugins.description: /skill-doctor:schem-it draws every skill, command and agent of a skill, plugin or marketplace as a flowchart; /skill-doctor:skill-qa tests a skill against realistic and edge-case scenarios and writes an evaluation report.
